page_title: AUG 1-0 HEI | Augsburg v Heidenheim 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Augsburg have a corner.
90+4' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+3' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Florian Pick (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
90+3' The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
89' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) replaces Fredrik Jensen.
89' It will be a substitution. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Phillip Tietz walks off.
88' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Frank Willenborg blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
84' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle after Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

82' Norman Theuerkauf sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

81' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
78' Here is a change. Jonas Fohrenbach is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
78' The game has come to an end for Jan-Niklas Beste. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
77' The attendance is 28000.
77' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' Arne Engels (Augsburg) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
74' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Substitution. Ruben Vargas walks off the pitch and Arne Engels (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
72' Good defending. Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) tries to find Iago inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will take a throw-in.
72' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
69' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Nikola Dovedan is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
69' A substitution has been made. Omar Haktab Traore is replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.

67' Great first touch by Iago (Augsburg) after collecting a pass deep into the box. He smashes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a fantastic reflex save and pushes it onto the bar. Brilliant goalkeeping! The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
62' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arne Maier departs the field of play to be replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
56' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Heidenheim is cautioned for aggressive play.
55' Frank Willenborg has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arne Maier (Augsburg).
53' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
52' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
51' The game is interrupted now, Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
48' The game is interrupted. Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
47' The ball is cleared after Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Dangerous play by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim). Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Frank Willenborg starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is substituted due to injury. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Norman Theuerkauf.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' The referee blows his whistle as Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
40' Iago (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Augsburg.
37' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
33' It looks like Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Frank Willenborg won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

32' Close! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
31' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Augsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike. The percentage of ball possession is – 64:36.
27' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
26' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Frank Willenborg saw the whole situation.

22' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Arne Maier delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is lurking. His close-range shot goes into the net and it's 1:0.
22' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
16' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Frank Willenborg interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
15' Augsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
13' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.
11' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

7' A precise low pass is received by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
7' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
6' Frank Willenborg interrupts the game. One of the players from Augsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Neat passing move from Heidenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Welz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Tobias Welz is the one to supervise the game today.
